test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 01 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate adverb.
The teacher explained the concept ___ for the students.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. clearly .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **clearly** is an adverb that modifies the verb **explained** in the sentence. Adverbs are used to describe how, when, or where an action takes place.
 
• Option 1 (**clear**) is incorrect because it is an adjective, not an adverb.
 
• Option 3 (**clearer**) is incorrect because it is a comparative form of the adjective and does not fit the grammatical structure of the sentence.
 
• Option 4 (**clarity**) is incorrect because it is a noun and does not modify the verb appropriately.

Correct sentence: *The teacher explained the concept **clearly** for the students*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Adjectives vs Adverbs:**
 
 
• **Adjectives:** Describe nouns or pronouns (e.g., clear instructions).
 
• **Adverbs:** Modify verbs, adjectives, or other adverbs (e.g., explained clearly).
 
 
 
• **Examples of adverbs:**
 
 
• He speaks **fluently**.
 
• She completed the task **quickly**.
